Real quick

Can I lease a beat?

No. No leases, no tiers, no stream caps. Buy it outright or don't.

What files do I get?

Exactly what's on the card. WAV-only beats deliver the WAV master. Full-file beats deliver MP3 + WAV + stems — same list in your order and agreement.

How does first come, first served work?

Simple: whoever buys it first gets it. The second it sells, it's pulled from the store for good — never sold to anyone else. Your agreement is the proof.

Payment plans?

No. One price, paid once — no payment options at checkout.

When do beats go on sale?

Flatline, Drip Check and Sun Up are live in the Vault now at $599 each. Flatline: MP3 + WAV master, no stems, no trackouts. Drip Check: WAV master + MP3, no stems, no trackouts. Sun Up: WAV master + MP3, no stems, no trackouts. More drops follow — drop your email in the vault section up top and you get first word before the next ones go live.

Publishing splits?

Set per song on the split sheet that comes with your sale — filled in for your record in the documents.
